description: Measure the horizontal distance between two objects on a site plan sheet. Uses AI vision to locate both objects on the cropped drawing, then computes the real-world distance using the sheet's engineering scale. Returns distance in feet with a confidence level.

reasoning.description: Explain in 1-4 sentences why you are calling this tool. Describe the compliance problem you are trying to solve, what information you have about the two objects (from blocks.md, vision, or other sources), and what distance threshold you need to verify.

applicable_checklist_items.description: The checklist items this measurement is intended to verify. Include every checklist item from your grouping file whose pass/fail determination depends on the distance between these two objects.

checklist_id.description: The checklist item ID from the grouping file (e.g., 'EL-2.5', 'EL-13.1').

checklist_deficiency_text.description: The full deficiency text from the checklist table (e.g., 'Trees proposed within 20 lateral feet of underground electric equipment lack required root barriers').

documentId.description: Plan set ID — the document UUID from the project README.md. This is NOT the projectId.

sheetNum.description: Sheet number containing the objects to measure.

objectPairs.description: Array of object pairs to measure distances between on this sheet. Each pair has an objectA and objectB. Provide all pairs you need measured in a single call — the tool downloads the sheet once and makes one Gemini call per pair.

objectA.description: Descriptive name of the first object. Be spatially specific (e.g., 'transformer pad in the northwest area near Building 1' not just 'transformer pad').

objectB.description: Descriptive name of the second object. Same guidance — be spatially specific.

scaleInchesPerFoot.description: Numeric ratio: drawing inches per real-world foot. For a sheet labeled '1" = 20'', pass 0.05 (which is 1 divided by 20). For '1" = 40'', pass 0.025. Must be a number, not a descriptive string.

localizationStrategy.description: Object localization strategy. Default 'a-then-b' tries vector matching first, falls back to Gemini Vision.
